segments.name: Electrical
segments.description: Manufactures conduit, cable and installation accessories for electrical power systems, sold to contractors through the electrical wholesale channel.
segments.evidence: The Electrical segment manufactures high quality products used in the construction of electrical power systems including conduit, cable, and installation accessories.

segments.name: Safety & Infrastructure
segments.description: Designs and manufactures metal framing, mechanical pipe, perimeter security and cable management protecting critical infrastructure, marketed to contractors, OEMs and end users.
segments.evidence: The Safety & Infrastructure segment designs and manufactures solutions including metal framing, mechanical pipe, perimeter security, and cable management for the protection and reliability of critical infrastructure.

revenueModel.text: Electrical wholesalers, contractors, original equipment manufacturers and end users pay Atkore for electrical products and safety and infrastructure solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: These solutions are marketed to contractors, original equipment manufacturers and end users.
